correctness.rationale: Each partial composite shifts by minus two and is determined by products of adjacent indicator digits. This proves the necessary and sufficient local equation. Run independence yields the partner-rank factorization; a unique nonzero-block decomposition proves the rational series; counting zero neighbors proves the sharp maximum and all dense-regime maximizers. Independent direct-composition enumerations through eight indicator positions and a ten-position extremal census corroborate each step. No finite check is used to infer an infinite identity.

value.rationale: The shift-one maps form a structurally essential portion of every minimal generator set for rank-ideals in the motivating paper, so their mutual commutation is a natural compatibility invariant. An explicit partner polynomial, a uniform trivariate rank census and a sharp rank-dependent maximum are nonroutine structural data not determined by the already known generator counts. The counting method is effective for arbitrary n and all ranks.
